statements.t: Commenting on Align's Q3'26 results, Align Technology President and CEO Joe Hogan said, “We delivered solid third-quarter results, with Q3 revenues and Clear Aligner volumes in line with our outlook and non-GAAP operating margin was above our prior guidance.
Disciplined expense management and productivity improvements contributed to non-GAAP operating margin of 24.4%, above our outlook.
This week, we will begin a U.S. pilot of a new product Invisalign ® Sports Guard -- a custom direct 3D printed sports mouth guards -- made from an iTero™ scan.
There is also significant overlap with our kids and teens demographic, and we expect it to drive awareness and utilization of Invisalign treatment through Invisalign doctors.”
